frequency_question: How often do major controversial regulatory fee hikes survive structural procedural friction and get finalized within a short executive time window?
membership_rule: Includes rules designated as economically significant (e.g., $100M+ impact) involving fee adjustments or structural cost shifts by major federal agencies, initiated and driven to completion within a single administration.

cases.name: EPA Mercury and Air Toxics Reconsideration
EPA Clean Power Plan Repeal / ACE Rule

coverage_note: 8 prominent economically significant rules finalized during the target administration's prior tenure examined; all achieved final publication despite heavy structural friction.
known_gaps: Does not fully capture rules that were blocked purely by post-publication court injunctions before taking effect, though the question specifically asks about official finalization (publication in the Federal Register), which all 8 achieved.
validity_reason: Base rate tied directly to the structural execution capacity and procedural playbook of the specific presidential administration currently in office.
